description: This file defines the ValidityBasedTrustOptions class, which implements TrustOptions and is used to configure trust managers that validate certificate validity based on 'not before' and 'not after' properties.

classes.name: ValidityBasedTrustOptions
classes.description: Provides trust options that validate certificates based on their validity period using a custom TrustManagerFactory.

methods.name: ValidityBasedTrustOptions
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the trust options with a new ValidityOnlyTrustManagerFactory instance.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ValidityBasedTrustOptions, facilitating copying of trust options.

methods.name: getTrustManagerFactory
methods.description: Returns the configured TrustManagerFactory to be used for SSL context.
